newsitem.title: LATVIA: MANGALI H1 NET PROFIT 3,051 LATS.
newsitem.headline: MANGALI H1 NET PROFIT 3,051 LATS.

text.p: Mangali Shipyard made a first-half 1997 net profit of 3,051 lats on net turnover of 693,934 lats, the bourse said on Monday.
The stock exchange said in a statement that Mangali's first-half gross profit was 106,414 lats and that its administrative expenses were 89,291 lats.
The company had profit before tax and extraordinary items of 19,102 lats and paid taxes of 13,166 lats.
The company's assets were 2.27 million lats and it had short-term debts of 818,048 lats. Its long-term debts were 52,304 lats.
